identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study of CD19-targeted Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T Cells Injection, for Relapsed and Refractory (R/R) Large B-cell Lymphoma

primaryOutcomes.description: Clinical response will be assessed by RECIST 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: PD of IL-2, IL-4, IL-6,IL-10, IL-15, IFN-γ, TNF-α will be analysed after CAR T cell infusion
Quality of life will be assessed by EQ-5D health Index scale
